title: A Sea of Cars in the Desert
description: Drag racer and auto mechanic Larry Harms has been running his autobody business in an Idaho desert since 1967. Over the years, L & L Classic Auto became one of the world’s largest salvage yards and the resting place for over 10,000 vehicles from rare Cadillacs and GMC Pacers to school buses. But in June 2026, a fast-moving wildfire swept through the yard, burning 9,000 vehicles.
translated_description: 直线加速赛车手兼汽车机械师拉里·哈姆斯自1967年以来一直在爱达荷州的一片沙漠中经营他的汽车车身修理业务。多年来，L & L Classic Auto成为世界上最大的废车场之一，也是超过10，000辆汽车的安息之地，从罕见的凯迪拉克和GMC Pacers到校车，应有尽有。但在2026年6月，一场快速蔓延的野火席卷了废车场，烧毁了9，000辆汽车。
